With that done, go west. Next, try to go to the north. Then, take a trip north. Then, venture west. Then, make an attempt to go west. With that over with, go to the west. Then, try to go to the north. Then, move west. And then, move north. If you can manage that, travel north. And then, attempt to go to the west. After that, make an attempt to take a trip north. If you can get around to doing that, make an effort to go to the north. That done, head north. With that accomplished, make an effort to head north. That done, attempt to head east. Then, go to the north. Once you manage that, try to take a trip east. After that, attempt to head north. Following that, go to the north. With that accomplished, make an attempt to go to the north. Next, venture east. If you can get through with that, try to head north. Then, make an attempt to venture east. Then, travel south. And then, head east. And then, head north. And then, attempt to head north. Following that, attempt to move west. After that, try to take a trip west. With that done, head north. Okay, and then, recover the coin from the floor of the gloomy spare room. And if you do that, you're the winner!
